r0025_result: D. AUTHORITY GAP: the independent fixture requirement cannot be implemented without an owner decision on the fixture world
scope: Assessment of the first independent MD-S003-R0025 fixture under D-MD-B18-A002-011. Diagnostics ran the real production path in rolled-back MariaDB transactions and wrote only to this raw package. No production, test, schema, matrix or protected-file change; no fixture package authored; no B10 binder or reproof; F-018 not started.

starting_state.authority_text: All required scenario families pass on MariaDB production semantics and the supported test mirror. Any missing family remains an open proof gap; historical green results for superseded rules do not close it.
starting_state.matrix_status: NOT_ASSESSED (formal); proof basis INCOMPLETE; B18 100/113 reviewed basis, formal 0/113
starting_state.failing_member: B18ScenarioFamiliesOnMariaDbTest::test_exact_publication_verification_family_on_mariadb (bullet "verify frozen observations, temporal revisions, config, factors, formulas, artifacts, hashes, manifest, seal, reasons, and terminal state;", scenario s_f1_frozen_inputs_and_seal)

d011_contract.chain: frozen inputs -> independently derived expected semantics -> independent review -> owner approval -> immutable versioned package -> target verification
d011_contract.authored_independently: the expected semantics, from frozen source inputs, observations, master revisions and configuration, by manual calculation, a reviewed spreadsheet or calculation artifact, or a separate reference implementation with identified method and version and derivation evidence traceable to those inputs
d011_contract.production_path_reusable: the actual side only: capture, publication assembly, semantic hashing, persistence and verification stay the real production path; an already executed target may be verified against the approved package
d011_contract.must_not_come_from_the_target: the produced publication row, hash, replay output, serializer output or repository result; a different run_id, a relabelled output, a free-form fixture_source or an expected-file presence is not independence
d011_contract.allowed_semantic_inputs: frozen inputs and authority text only; target output may be read for comparison after the independent values exist
d011_contract.circular_evidence: REPLAY_FIXTURE_SELF_GENERATED: a fixture family runtime_generated_* or a fixture_source naming the run under verification
d011_contract.fail_closed: REPLAY_FIXTURE_SELF_GENERATED stays fail-closed; missing expected proof is BLOCKED (REPLAY_EXPECTED_PROOF_INCOMPLETE); a skip is never a pass
d011_contract.package_requirements: manifest binds frozen-input identity and lineage, oracle/method ID and version, derivation reference, fixture version, expected-content identity, canonical SHA-256 of every file; volatile operational identities must not enter semantic expected-content hashes
d011_contract.admission_requirements: a governed review record naming reviewer identity, derivation evidence, owner approval and the approved package and manifest fingerprint, issued BEFORE the proof claim; the later target-verification record cites that fingerprint and names the run and publication
d011_contract.not_weakened: nothing in this unit relaxes D011 or removes the self-generated rejection

circularity_root_cause.circularity_point: buildExpectedReplayResultFromActual consumes buildActualReplayState of the very run being verified: expected := actual. The test supplies no other expectation.
circularity_root_cause.diagnostic_not_patched: The rejection is correct and stays; it is the behaviour R0025 requires. The member fails because it feeds the verifier its own output, not because of a verifier fault.

meaning.SEMANTIC_DERIVABLE_FROM_AUTHORITY_AND_FR: terminal status, publishability, coverage counts and ratio, thresholds, gate state, reason codes, source mode and file facts, seal state, pointer and fallback state, price product, resolution mode: authorable now from the contracts and the one-bar frozen input
meaning.INDEPENDENTLY_DERIVABLE_FROM_FROZEN_FILE: source_file_hash and source_identity: SHA-256 of the frozen file bytes
meaning.TARGET_OPERATIONAL_ID: run, publication, factor-set, pointer and scope ids: allocated per run; D011 requires them bound by the target-verification record, never authored as expected truth; the verifier has no placeholder for target-bound identities today
meaning.ALLOCATION_BOUND_HASH_V1: bars, indicators, eligibility and factor-set hashes: serialize local ids (listing_id, config_snapshot_id, sector and status revision ids)
meaning.CONFIGURATION_CONTENT_HASH_NEEDS_FROZEN_: config identity: stable across allocations, but production resolves the live registry; an independent value needs a frozen configuration input the pipeline does not accept

executed_allocation_proof.method: the same frozen world (same file, same bar, same configuration) run twice in separate processes through the real pipeline in rolled-back MariaDB transactions; auto-increment advanced between them
executed_allocation_proof.reading: identical semantic inputs give different bars, indicators, eligibility, factor-set, observation-manifest and publication-manifest hashes; only the source file hash and the config identity are stable. A literal independently authored hash for this world is impossible: it would be wrong on the next run.

independence_feasibility.profile: the test environment runs market-data-row-hash/v1 (phpunit.xml); production defaults to v2. V2 hashes drop local ids but require a retained foundation identity per listing, and R25X has none (a listing without one is HELD).
independence_feasibility.consequence: An expectation that satisfies section 6A ("volatile operational identities MUST NOT be substituted into semantic expected-content hashes") needs a world whose hashes are allocation-independent: a V2 run over a listing with a retained identity. No such end-to-end pipeline world exists in the tests; V2 tests seed rows and hash stored artifacts, drive the repositories directly, or mock the pipeline.

f003_impact.verdict: NOT AFFECTED; leave OPEN for its B18 predicate owners
f003_impact.basis: F-MD-B10-A002-003 concerns a later run, with an earlier knowledge cutoff, reusing a platform-created assessment or factor set recorded after that cutoff through AdjustmentFactorSetService::produceForPublication. The R0025 scenarios never run that path across runs: the exact-publication scenario is one producing run consuming its own records, and the as-known family captures through AsKnownReplaySnapshotService (a read) over rows inserted by the test, which differ only in recorded_at. grep of the test finds no produceForPublication, createAsKnownReplayRun or replay_verify use.
f003_impact.owners: MD-S004-R0002, MD-S050-R0028 and MD-S019-R0074 (as the finding names); their proof basis is not changed here
f003_impact.caveat: The family bullet that factor revisions are invisible before their recorded time is proven at the snapshot-service level; an end-to-end as-known replay run that binds a producer-reused record is not exercised and is the finding's own subject.

f004_impact.verdict: AFFECTED, as a prerequisite of the independent exact-publication fixture only
f004_impact.basis: The exact-publication bullet requires verifying frozen temporal revisions and factors. An independent expected value for temporal_identity_hash or event_factor_hash must not move with allocation (D-MD-B10-A002-005, section 6A). Captured replay content still carries V1 ticker_id, issuer_id, instrument_id and listing_id, so those identities move when listings are re-allocated. The current member does not assert them (BOUND_INPUT_FIELDS are checked for presence only), which is why it was not exposed before.
f004_impact.required_direction: For V2-profile publications, build replay frozen identities from retained foundation roots and content, fail closed (BLOCKED) when a listing has no retained identity, and prove it with an allocation-history probe; keep V1-profile interpretation unchanged. Do not drop keys and do not substitute ticker or listing ids.
f004_impact.not_done_here: Not implemented in this unit: it can only be validated on the V2 retained-identity world that the owner decision below chooses, and no such end-to-end world exists yet.

minimum_questions.question: Which world carries the first independent exact-publication golden?
minimum_questions.why_authority_does_not_decide: Section 6A forbids operational ids in expected-content hashes, which excludes the current V1 world; Golden_Fixtures_Specification says synthetic cases are labelled and cannot replace required real-market semantic cases; the only retained foundation identity is IKPM at one admitted instant. Authority does not say whether the exact-publication golden is a real-market case.

options.A: A synthetic, labelled retained-identity world on the V2 profile (independently declared roots, as tests/Support/SecurityIdentityFixture does), with literal allocation-independent expected hashes from a separate reference implementation. Fastest and fully controlled; needs the owner to accept that the first R0025 golden is synthetic.
options.B: A real-market frozen IKPM case at its admitted instant on V2: a sanitized frozen bar with source, retrieval time and licensing notes. Most authentic; needs data stewardship by the foundation owner first.
options.C: Keep the V1 world and assert only allocation-independent fields (about 94 semantic leaves, the file hash) with the allocation-bound hashes checked by recomputation from stored rows instead of literals. Smallest change; weakens what the bullet says ("hashes, manifest") and needs authority to accept recomputation as an independent oracle.

minimum_questions.recommendation: A for the first package, with the real-market IKPM case kept as its own later mandatory family; the owner decides

minimum_questions.question: Who is the independent reviewer, and does the owner approve the package fingerprint once it exists?
minimum_questions.why_authority_does_not_decide: D011 requires reviewer identity and owner approval before admission. The author of a package cannot be its independent reviewer, and no approval can precede the package.
minimum_questions.needed: a named reviewer and, after review, an approval record bound to the package and manifest fingerprint

minimum_questions.question: Confirm the F-MD-B10-A002-004 direction: retained-root replay identities for V2-profile publications only, fail closed without a retained identity, V1 unchanged.
minimum_questions.why_authority_does_not_decide: The finding says "retained roots, not key filters" but does not scope it to a profile; applying it to V1 publications would turn every existing non-foundation B18 fixture world BLOCKED.

build the chosen V2 retained-identity pipeline world
add verifier support for target-bound operational identities and an admission check for independent packages (manifest oracle fields, no runtime_generated family)
author the package and its separate reference oracle, with derivation evidence
review and approval record; then the target-verification member, its sensitivity, independence and anti-circularity probes, and the R0025 aggregate

next_resume_point: MD-B18-A002: F-MD-B18-A002-017 / MD-S003-R0025 waits on an owner decision (E-MD-B18-A002-091, F-MD-B18-A002-025). R0025 is INCOMPLETE because its exact-publication member verifies a fixture built from its own run (REPLAY_FIXTURE_SELF_GENERATED, correctly rejected), and a D-MD-B18-A002-011 independent fixture cannot carry allocation-independent hashes in the current V1 world. The owner decides Q1 (the world for the first independent golden: synthetic V2 retained identity, real-market IKPM V2, or V1 with recomputed hashes), names the independent reviewer (Q2) and confirms the F-MD-B10-A002-004 direction (Q3: retained-root replay identities for V2 publications only). After that: F-004 residual, the V2 world, verifier support for target-bound identities, the package and its reference oracle, review and approval, then the member probes and the aggregate. MD-DEP-0019 is resolved; MD-DEP-0015 still gates closure; F-018 is not started; B10 stays closed.
